text:
Carmen: kicking off DayZero for the silicon onramp EAP — quick sync on deliverables and blockers. NDA is signed, partner sent initial kit ETA Tue.
Derek: great — who owns the lab slot schedule? I can take day-of run queue if needed.
Carmen: @Derek please own the run queue. Sasha will own telemetry and logs. Ben — can you prep the benchmark matrix and perf script?
Ben: on it. I sketched a matrix: latency p50/p95, throughput (tokens/s), memory footprint, and power draw snapshots. Will push a small harness.
Sasha: sharing telemetry plan: we need KV cache traces, seq len distribution, and cold-start traces. Will add secure key rotation for partner-kms.
Nate: heads up — partner asked for cloud marketplace checklist (tile metadata + compliance docs) so marketing can prep the listing once we clear embargo.
Carmen: embargo note — joint announcement window = 2 weeks after final perf signoff. Legal wants approval on copy + partner quote before any previews.
eap-bot: NDA status update: partner "Artemis Labs" — signed by both parties 2026-03-10. Access tokens created (token: ART-EAP-xxxx).
Derek: lab slot update: partner kit arriving Tue 09:00 PST. I've reserved Node-4 and Node-5 09:30-16:30 Tue-Wed. Prep image: rwi/inference-eap:dayzero-202603.
Ben: benchmark snippet (local run):
```bash
python run_bench.py --model rwi/quant-v2 --batch 8 --seq 2048 --itrs 300 --trace kv
```
Ben: sample output (truncated):
```
iter 100 | p50 12.3ms | p95 45.9ms | tokens/s 1850
memory_peak 6.1GB | power 210W
```
Sasha: small ask — partner HW reported a flaky fan on unit #2 last week. Can ops bring a spare? I also want to enable verbose hw-telemetry for the first two runs.
Derek: ops confirmed spare fans on standby. I'll log a hot-swap window just in case.
Carmen: checklist for Tuesday: 1) NDA confirmed (done), 2) kit receipt + physical QC, 3) image + runtime smoke, 4) telemetry keys in vault, 5) run bench matrix, 6) collect logs and upload to secure S3, 7) start internal signoff doc.
Ben: will add a small regression prompt set to run after perf passes — catches quality regressions from quant/compile changes.
Nate: marketplace task: I'll build a placeholder tile with feature flags disabled. We need partner logo and a single screenshot — can someone collect from partner PM?
Carmen: @Sasha please ping partner PM for logo and contact for joint quote. Also confirm whether they want us to co-host the announcement webinar.
Sasha: pinged PM now. They said logo + quote by EOD Monday, webinar TBD.
Derek: one more — please keep run notes inline in this thread with short bullets so I can paste into the ops runbook.
Carmen: agreed. I'll post runbook link after first smoke: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/eap-dayzero-1732105555 (will attach artifacts there).
Ben: noted. If we hit any perf regressions >10% we pause and do a compile rollback to quant-v1.
Sasha: telemetry retention: capture raw traces for 7 days then rollup to 90-day aggregates for quality evals.
Carmen: thanks everyone — let's reconvene Wed 17:00 PT for first-pass signoff. :thumbsup:
